verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no first-party data-export feature, such as an account or project export in open formats. The REST API and OpenAPI spec, the file download endpoint, and calendar subscriptions are developer building blocks or adjacent features a user could script an export from, not an export capability itself. Self-serve cancellation covers only the 'leave' half of the story, not taking your data with you.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
